notes.after: The primary study names Faecalibacterium duncaniae DSM 17677T and explicitly notes its former name Faecalibacterium prausnitzii. Separately, the pinned kg-microbe NCBI2GTDB.tsv.gz reference correspondence (SHA-256 761d5537a7edb4b0133e88e7bbc85570cf3cb6f2555b9f9ce6cca3e1056a0ddd) resolves the exact NCBITaxon:411483 descriptor row to GTDB Faecalibacterium duncaniae, with 5,099 reference genomes and stored majority fraction 1.0. That crosswalk's GTDB release is not established. The independently verified official R232 NCBI-versus-GTDB workbook (SHA-256 e401d80c914c727268c184d19201aa35dcd23aabfd027a0d6e5a57476e71f3de), Species worksheet, has no exact NCBI-name row under Faecalibacterium duncaniae; the name occurs in the GTDB result column of five different NCBI-name rows. This is not absence of the GTDB species. Row136's historical-name Faecalibacterium prausnitzii population has 948 genomes and 57 GTDB clusters, including F.duncaniae at8.65%, and must not replace the current descriptor's population. These reference populations neither establish the experimental DSM17677T genome's GTDB assignment nor revise the source's stock identity. The original curation event remains a historical record of its earlier disposition, not a new current-source assertion.

notes.after: The primary study names Desulfovibrio piger DSM 749T as an MDSC member. Separately, the pinned kg-microbe NCBI2GTDB.tsv.gz reference correspondence (SHA-256 761d5537a7edb4b0133e88e7bbc85570cf3cb6f2555b9f9ce6cca3e1056a0ddd) resolves the encoded species descriptor through the NCBI-name route to GTDB Desulfovibrio piger, with 156 reference genomes and stored majority fraction 1.0; no exact NCBITaxon:901 row occurs in that crosswalk. Its GTDB release is not established. The independently verified official R232 NCBI-versus-GTDB workbook (SHA-256 e401d80c914c727268c184d19201aa35dcd23aabfd027a0d6e5a57476e71f3de), Species worksheet row544, describes a different NCBI-name population: 76 genomes across six GTDB clusters. The unnamed Desulfovibrio sp900556755 cluster has57.89%, named D.piger22.37%, D.piger_A15.79%, and three other clusters1.32% each. Thus that R232 population has a majority cluster; the earlier no-majority wording was inaccurate. The two source populations must not be pooled or described as older/newer without a verified release relationship. Neither population identifies DSM749T's experimental genome or justifies assigning that stock to the unnamed R232 majority. Source stock identity and the original historical curation event remain preserved.
